step1.title: Welcome to St.Georgen!
step1.description: I'm Georgi, your dragon guide. Together we'll discover St.Georgen on exciting tourist themed trails full of history, culture, and adventure!
step1.georgiMessage: Hey! Ready for an unforgettable journey of discovery?

step2.title: Choose Your Tourist Themed Trail
step2.description: Pick a tourist themed trail that interests you. Each trail leads you to special places in St.Georgen - whether historic sights, nature experiences, or cultural highlights!
step2.georgiMessage: Tourist themed trails are perfect for starting!

step3.title: Experience AR at Stations
step3.description: Visit the stations in any order. At each station, an exciting AR experience awaits you - discover interactive content, solve quiz questions, and collect points!
step3.georgiMessage: The nearest stations will always be shown first!

step4.title: Claim Your Rewards
step4.description: With collected points, you unlock vouchers that you can redeem at real locations in St.Georgen - cafés, restaurants, museums, and more!
step4.georgiMessage: Collect points diligently and enjoy great rewards on-site!

tourist.title: Tourist Themed Trails
tourist.description: Discover the highlights of St.Georgen on this exciting tour through history, culture and nature.

glockenspiel.description: Experience the historic carillon in AR
glockenspiel.longDescription: The carillon is a fascinating historic instrument. Discover in the AR experience how the mechanics work and hear the traditional melodies.

quiz.question: How many bells does the carillon have?

phonomuseum.description: Discover historic musical instruments in AR
phonomuseum.longDescription: The Phonographic Museum shows the fascinating history of sound recording and playback. Experience in AR how historic phonographs and gramophones work.

klosterweiher.description: Explore nature at the historic monastery pond
klosterweiher.longDescription: The Monastery Pond is an idyllic natural place with rich history. Discover in the AR experience the animal and plant world and learn more about the historical significance of the pond.

quiz.question: Which animal species is particularly common to see at the Monastery Pond?
